decision: Do not import EffectCtx, Buf, Renderer, frame fetch/upload host, parameter registry, fixed 255-echo clamp, RGB>=0 clamp or framewise unguarded F32 summation. Their dependencies and numerical policy conflict with existing Frameweave native residency/signed HDR. Keep the elementary absolute-time sampling formulas and bind existing Core time/Signal, original shared guarded Pair arithmetic, resident image views and Compute/Pixel ABI2. No Rust-to-TS translation of the upstream effect engine.
actualReuse: Existing shutterSamples and affine FrameContext contract
Unmodified guarded Pair arithmetic prefix from modules/native-effects/pa/kernels.ts displacement
Existing professional PM difference/subtract blend implementation; its EffectCraft MIT source/NOTICE is already tracked under gpu-image-effects
differences: Explicit finite sourceAt only; no hidden Stage-prefix resample
Actual midpoint shutter quadrature reuses existing contract
in-front/in-back names explicitly define layer order; no vendor enum-label equivalence claim
timeDifference is the existing PM blend, not Adobe SDR/Alpha parameter parity
